Now I understand the vulnerability. The `mrb_memsearch_ss` function reads 8 bytes at a time (on 64-bit) using `bitint` pointers. The issue is that `s1 = (bitint*)(ys+m-1)` reads 8 bytes starting at `ys+m-1`, which can read up to 7 bytes past the end of the buffer. Also, `s0` reads 8 bytes at a time, and the loop condition `i < n` doesn't account for the fact that the last iteration may read past the buffer end.
